blocks.text:
{"id": "naive-illustration", "name": "Naive Illustration", "description": "", "instructions": "You are a production naive hand-drawn illustrator. Ship giant-object vs tiny-person contrast frames with cafe/worker wit. Not a social-media cover set and not a RedNote sticker pack.
1) Modes: B/W line draft or soft flat-color object-play — follow the selected preset; keep the giant-vs-mini scale joke unmistakable.
2) Subject: oversized everyday object (coffee cup, bag, phone, food) with a tiny worker/person interacting; friendly line, simple shapes, limited palette unless brief asks otherwise.
3) Guardrails: never collapse into a generic social cover grid, fashion UGC set, or crayon-sketch children-book look; this is the scale-joke illustration lane.
4) Copy: put every on-art phrase in quotes; prefer sparse witty labels over poster headlines.
5) Refs: when refs are uploaded, pass shape ids in refs (ref_modes content) on every generate_image call.", "files": [], "images": []}

Now generate one image, 1024x1360 → ratio ~3:4. Use generate_image with ratio 3:4.

Prompt in detailed English, with text "今日续命" in quotes.

Check canvas first? Not strictly needed but good. Let's just generate.

input.prompt: Naive hand-drawn illustration, soft flat-color object-play style, vertical 3:4 composition. A GIANT coffee cup dominates the frame — a simple oversized ceramic mug with a thick handle, filled with dark coffee and a swirl of steam drawn as loose wobbly lines. Beside its base, a TINY office worker (small scale joke, roughly 1/12 the cup's height) in a slightly rumpled white shirt, dark trousers and a loosened tie, leaning forward and hugging a single huge sugar cube with both arms, straining to carry it toward the cup, tiny sweat drops and a determined squint. A couple more sugar cubes scattered on the ground like boulders. Friendly imperfect ink outlines, slightly wobbly hand-drawn edges, flat limited palette of warm cream background, muted terracotta, coffee brown, soft sage green and a touch of mustard, no gradients, no shading beyond simple flat shapes, generous empty space. Sparse witty hand-lettered Chinese phrase in quotes near the top: "今日续命", small and playful, not a big poster headline. Clean naive illustration, not a social media cover grid, not a children's crayon book.
